conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: Those visions......No, it's just a nightmare. Just a nightmare.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: Noema, my best friend back in high school. I can't even remember the last time I dreamed about her.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: She promised we'd stay in touch after graduation. But once college started, she never texted me—not even once did she reply to my messages.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: Why would she suddenly invite me here...? Never mind. No use dwelling on it. I’ll ask her in person when we meet.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: I should get up, stretch a little, and head to the restroom.
